Source signal interpretation limits

Reported signal describes this comparison, not calibrated amount or isolated activity. Domains retain reported estimates and finite outward rounding, not sampling confidence. Dependent transforms do not add independent evidence. Numeric uncertainty, calibration, functional-response and observation-model readers remain unimplemented here.
